  ## Status

  **Approved 2026-10-15** after six review waves (R1-R6). Scope: `apps/wm-cli` only. No changes to `wm-core` or `packages/*`.

  ## Context

  `apps/wm-cli/src/main.rs` is the largest `.rs` file in the workspace:

  | Metric | Value |
  |---|---|
  | `main.rs` | 3,058 lines (next-largest non-test file: 2,190) |
  | `apps/wm-cli` total | 6,318 lines, so `main.rs` is **48%** of the crate |
  | `async fn main()` | 2,061 lines (:998 to EOF), 21 top-level `Commands` arms, ~50 leaf actions |
  | Types / fns | 15 clap enums + 2 structs; 16 fns; 231 print macros (229 `println!`) |
  | Inline asset | 4,986-byte `AGENTS.md` template inside the Init arm (:1043-1152) |

  Measured arm budgets: Health 311, Init 309, Page 235, Graph 230, Model 103, Index 85, Config 82, Source 79, Status 74, Task 67, Log 64, Time 60, Lint 54, Setup 41, Decide 39, Validate 25, Mcp 23, Agents 17, MigrateMemory 7, Version 3.

  Existing structure to preserve as precedent: `src/constants/` (`fs`, `health`, `wiki`, `mod`), `src/models/` (`output_format`, `mod`), root `src/mcp_server.rs` (87).

  ## Constraints

  1. One primary type per file; exception is tightly coupled helpers under 20 lines.
  2. Role-suffixed filenames in role directories (`models/`, `services/`, `helpers/`, `constants/`); every directory gets a `mod.rs` barrel. **Gap flagged**: `traits/` is not in the documented role-directory list although `apps/wm-core/src/shared/traits/` exists.
  3. Shared-code rule, refined by C8.
  4. `no-comments-in-code` — zero comments including rustdoc.
  5. `no-warnings` and `no-dead-code-clone-scanning` after every step (including `unused_async`).
  6. `no-compensating-layers`, `no-else`, `no-magic-values`, YAGNI.
  7. TDD; **behaviour freeze**: command names, flags, help text, stdout and exit codes unchanged.
  8. **C-share**: an item is shared when it has **2 or more consumers**, counted mechanically at call sites, including items that only become shared after the split. One consumer means it stays with its consumer.
  9. **C-decompose**: a function whose behaviour is not self-evident from name and structure is a defect. Every function targets 20 lines or fewer; verbatim lift is not sufficient.

  ## Options considered

  | Option | Tree | Verdict |
  |---|---|---|
  | **A - Role dirs + uniform per-command dirs + first-class `shared/`** (chosen) | `shared/{traits,models,services,helpers}/`; 21 `services/<command>/` dirs; one router file | Zero rule violations; uniform granularity; satisfies C-share mechanically; mirrors `wm-core/src/shared/` |
  | B - Feature-first `commands/<name>/` | non-sanctioned directory; `Cli`/`Commands` homeless | Rejected |
  | C - Hybrid `commands/` plus `models/` | two homes per feature | Rejected |
  | D - Minimal concern split | ~2,300-line `main.rs` remains | Rejected: fails the goal and the budget |
  | E - Dispatch registry or factory | trait object plus `Box<dyn>` plus dynamic dispatch | **Rejected, see D8** |

  ## Decision - target module map

  ```
  apps/wm-cli/src/                                       (~91 files)
    main.rs                    (~50, cap 80)
    constants/                 unchanged (fs, health, wiki, mod)
    models/                    unchanged (output_format.rs, mod.rs)
    mcp_server.rs              out of scope
    shared/
      mod.rs
      traits/  mod.rs, command.rs
      models/  25 files + mod.rs: Cli, Commands, 14 action/support enums, 9 leaf args structs
      services/  mod.rs, engine_service.rs, engine_proxy.rs, agent_file_sync_service.rs, platform_mcp_service.rs
      helpers/  mod.rs, logging_helper.rs, project_root_helper.rs   [recorded C-share exception]
    services/
      mod.rs
      command_dispatch_service.rs                            (~28)
      <command>/{mod.rs, <command>_service.rs}               x 21 uniform directories
  ```

  The 21 command directories: init, mcp, setup, agents, search, page, graph, health, source, task, log, lint, validate, index, time, model, decide, status, config, version, migrate_memory.

  Dependency direction: command directories depend on `shared`, which depends on `wm-core` and `constants`. The single reverse edge is the router, which references all 21 command directories because it is the composition root.

  ## Placement

  | Item | Destination | Basis |
  |---|---|---|
  | `trait Command` | `shared/traits/command.rs` (unsuffixed, named after the trait, mirroring wm-core) | 21 consumers |
  | `impl Command` x 21 | inside each command module | impls live beside the behaviour they implement |
  | `Cli`, `Commands`, 14 action enums, 9 leaf args structs | `shared/models/` | consumed by the dispatch; recorded structural exception to C-share for `Cli`/`Commands` |
  | `call_tool` (31 call sites), `EngineHandle`, `engine_handle` | `shared/services/engine_proxy.rs` | C-share; `_proxy` denotes lazy init and access control |
  | `create_engine`, `build_engine`, `rebuild_from_engine` | `shared/services/engine_service.rs` | 2-3 consumers each |
  | `sync_agent_files`, `sync_skills_to` | `shared/services/agent_file_sync_service.rs` | 3 and 6 consumers |
  | `setup_platform_mcp`, `resolve_mcp_binary`, `patch_mcp_command` | `shared/services/platform_mcp_service.rs` | 2, 2, 5 consumers |
  | `setup_query_before_grep` | `services/setup/query_before_grep_service.rs` | 1 consumer, stays with Setup |
  | `determine_project_root` | `shared/helpers/project_root_helper.rs` | promoted as a recorded exception (1 call site) |
  | `setup_logging` | `main.rs` (private, decomposed) | 1 call site; auto-promotes on a second consumer |
  | `health_status_label` | `services/health/health_service.rs` (private) | 1 consumer |
  | `AGENTS.md` template | travels with the Init arm | data, not logic; final home is D3 |
  | nested `print_config` | `services/config/config_service.rs` | travels with the Config arm |

  ## Decomposition mandate

  Every function targets 20 lines or fewer, single responsibility, verb+object naming, intent evident without comments. Entry shapes are uniform: all 21 commands implement `Command`, so all 21 dispatch arms read identically.

  Named exceptions to the 20-line target, each justified:

  | Item | Lines | Why |
  |---|---|---|
  | the `AGENTS.md` raw string | ~110 | data, not logic; frozen for behaviour fidelity |
  | `dispatch` | ~25 | flat match, one statement per arm, cyclomatic complexity about 1; splitting into read/write groups would be artificial |
  | `Commands` enum | ~125 | a type, not a function |

  Per-command decomposition (entry plus named helpers) is specified in the review record on `wiki:tasks:controlled-rewrite-of-appswm-clisrcmainrs--one-architecture-decision-per-review`. The mechanical acceptance criterion: after the rewrite, no function exceeds 20 lines except the three named above.

  ## D8 - dispatch and the Command trait

  **Decided.** `main()` becomes `setup_logging()` then `Cli::parse()` then the help fallback then `dispatch(cli.command).await`. `dispatch` is an exhaustive `match` over `Commands` with 21 arms, living in `services/command_dispatch_service.rs`.

  **The trait, shared, static dispatch:**

  ```rust
  pub trait Command {
      fn run(self) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), anyhow::Error>> + Send;
  }
  ```

  - Implemented by all 21 commands: the 12 grouped commands through their Action enum (`impl Command for SearchAction`), the 9 leaf commands through a per-leaf args struct (`impl Command for InitArgs`).
  - Leaf variants become single-field tuple variants carrying their args struct, so every arm is identical: `Commands::Search { action } => action.run().await` and `Commands::Init(args) => args.run().await`.
  - The explicit `+ Send` bound is deliberate: bare `async fn` in a trait gives no `Send` bound by default, which would break any future `tokio::spawn`. It also removes the sync/async problem, because four commands (Health, Model, Log, Config) never `.await` and would otherwise trip clippy`s `unused_async`; they return `async move { .. }` instead.
  - Static dispatch only: monomorphised, no `Box`, no vtable, no allocation. `Box<dyn Command>` and any registry or `HashMap` dispatch are **rejected** — the cost is real and the command set is closed. clap yields a closed enum the compiler enumerates exhaustively, so `enum` plus `match` is the zero-cost form of closed-set selection.
  - The exhaustive `match` **remains**: it converts `Commands` into the concrete type, which is also where exhaustiveness is enforced.
  - Trait **revisited trigger**: if the command set ever becomes dynamic or plugin-loaded, the factory precondition appears and D8 reopens.
  - The trait is the repository`s first async-fn-in-trait style contract. There is no `async-trait` dependency and none is added.
  - Naming notes recorded: `std::process::Command` is used only inside the Init arm, fully qualified and never imported, so it cannot collide with the trait; that must be preserved. The trait is implemented by Action enums and args structs, so `impl Command for SearchAction` reads slightly off, since `SearchAction` is a sub-action rather than the command itself; `Action` and `Runnable` were considered and rejected.

  ## Size budget and enforcement

  **Hard cap 300 lines per `.rs` file; `main.rs` at most 80; functions at most 20 (three named exceptions above).**

  Enforced by a deterministic CI check in the `check` job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, placed after the existing `Build wm-cli` step. This follows the existing `#[allow(...)]`-ban precedent, which is likewise a deterministic CI grep rather than a lint or a test crate. Dependency-free `find`/`wc` shell, no new test directory: `apps/wm-cli` has no `tests/` directory today.

  Expected largest files after the split: page ~230, graph ~225, init_service ~205 (about 95 once the template relocates under D3), health_audit ~170, platform_mcp ~146, search ~130, commands_model ~125. All within 300.

  ## Explicit non-decisions

  | # | Topic | This decision states |
  |---|---|---|
  | D2 | clap surface mechanism | types placed in `shared/models/` with derives intact; mechanism decided later |
  | D3 | `AGENTS.md` template | travels inline with the Init arm; relocation decided later |
  | D4 | `EngineHandle` and `OnceLock` lifecycle | located in `shared/services/engine_proxy.rs`; **must reuse or extend** `apps/wm-core/src/engine/main_engine_factory.rs` — no second construction path. Internals open |
  | D5 | agent-sync cluster boundary | two shared service files today; finer split later |
  | D6 | output layer for 229 `println!` | per-command `print_*` functions; abstraction later |
  | D7 | `anyhow` versus typed errors | `Result<_, anyhow::Error>` preserved verbatim |
  | - | per-command construction | a `*_builder_service.rs` inside the command directory, never a central factory |
  | - | `traits/` role-directory gap | flagged; recommendation is to amend CONVENTIONS to add `traits/`, or document `shared/traits/` as the accepted exception |

  ## Migration ordering

  | Step | Content | Commits |
  |---|---|---|
  | 0 | **Characterization net**: golden `--help` for the binary and all 21 subcommands, plus per-leaf stdout goldens for deterministic read-only actions, generated from the **pre-move** binary | 1 |
  | 1 | `shared/` skeleton: `shared/mod.rs`, `shared/traits/{mod.rs,command.rs}`, `shared/models/` (25 files + barrel), `shared/services/mod.rs`, `shared/helpers/`; `main.rs` import switch | 1 |
  | 2 | Shared services, one file per commit, move then decompose: engine_service, engine_proxy, agent_file_sync, platform_mcp | 4 |
  | 3 | **21 per-command commits**: create directory and `mod.rs`, move the arm verbatim into the entry, verify byte-identity, decompose into named functions under 20 lines, then a one-line delegation in the router. Verify clap tuple-variant flattening and the `unused_async` behaviour at the health, model, log and config commits. Order: version, migrate_memory, agents, validate, decide, config, model, time, log, lint, task, source, index, search, page, graph, status, setup, mcp, health, init | 21 |
  | 4 | Extract `dispatch` to `services/command_dispatch_service.rs`, slim `main.rs`, **add the CI budget step** (red to green in the same commit), add in-process routing tests | 2-3 |
  | 5 | Optional and separate: re-home `mcp_server.rs`; remove the unused `rayon` and `chrono` dependencies | 1 |

  **Riskiest step is 3**, because decomposition means arms are no longer moved verbatim and byte-identity `git diff` no longer covers the change. The step-0 goldens carry that load.

  ## Risks

  | Risk | Consequence | Mitigation |
  |---|---|---|
  | Decomposition drifts stdout or exit codes | behaviour freeze broken | goldens per leaf, two-phase commits, bottom-up extraction only |
  | 20-line function cap judged rigid | review friction | three named exceptions, further exceptions need sign-off |
  | clap `Args` flattening into a tuple variant does not work | leaf args structs unusable | verified at step 3 before the pattern spreads |
  | `unused_async` on non-awaiting impls | warning breaks `no-warnings` | RPITIT signature removes `async fn` entirely |
  | 91 files versus 8 today | navigation cost | accepted, for uniform granularity and per-command commit independence |

  ## Reviewer amendments incorporated

  | Wave | Amendment |
  |---|---|
  | R1 | Uniform one directory per command (all 21, including tiny ones); no inline arms; Health decomposed inside its own directory; budget as a CI check in the `check` job |
  | R2 | Shared module first-class |
  | R3 | Share means 2 or more consumers, counted mechanically; decomposition mandate: 20-line functions, names carry intent, no comments needed |
  | R4 | Dispatch is an extracted exhaustive match, not a factory; D4 reuses `main_engine_factory.rs` |
  | R5 | The `Command` trait is mandatory and shared at `shared/traits/command.rs`, unsuffixed, mirroring wm-core, with impls in each command module |
  | R6 | Trait signature restored to RPITIT with an explicit `+ Send` as the primary form; **21/21 coverage** through per-leaf args structs; `shared/helpers/` populated as a recorded exception; attribution corrected (the `CommandRunner` name was proposed by the architecture lane and corrected to `Command` by the reviewer) |

  ## Open recommendations

  1. Create `@wiki/rules/file-size-budget` (one invariant plus a pointer to the CI step). Requires reviewer approval because creating rules is a governance act. The CI step ships regardless.
  2. Land the unused `rayon` and `chrono` dependency removal as a **separate** commit, so every map commit remains behaviour-frozen and independently revertible.
  3. Amend CONVENTIONS to add `traits/` to the role-directory list, or document `shared/traits/` as the accepted exception.

  The 21 domains: agents, config, decide, graph, health, index, init, lint, log, mcp, migrate_memory, model, page, search, setup, source, status, task, time, validate, version.

  Dependency direction: `<domain>` -> `shared` -> `wm-core`, `constants`. The single reverse edge is the router, which references all 21 domains because it is the composition root.

  ## Superseded layout (recorded so it is not reintroduced)

  The first version of this decision nested the domains inside a root `services/` role directory (`services/<domain>/`), with per-leaf args models and action enums in `shared/models/`. It was **rejected** because it inverted the repo shape (constraint 2) and split every domain across two homes — the service under `services/<domain>/` and its own model under `shared/models/`. That is the same two-homes defect for which an earlier option was rejected. Commit `5cfba93` moved the domains to the crate root and moved each domain`s models into its own directory; `shared/models/` now holds only `Cli` and `Commands`.

  ## Decomposition mandate

  Every function targets 20 lines or fewer, single responsibility, verb+object naming, intent evident without comments.

  Named exceptions: the `AGENTS.md` raw string (~110, data not logic); `dispatch` (~25, flat match, complexity about 1); the `Commands` enum (a type); and `run_page_action` (28) with `run_graph_action` (20) — flat per-domain dispatchers, exempted rather than satisfied with panic sites (R8).

  ## D8 - dispatch and the Command trait

  `main()` is `setup_logging()`, `Cli::parse()`, the help fallback, then a 21-arm exhaustive `match` delegating to `run`. `dispatch` moves to `command_dispatch_service.rs` in step 4.

  ```rust
  pub trait Command {
      fn run(self) -> impl Future<Output = Result<(), anyhow::Error>> + Send;
  }
  ```

  - Implemented by all 21 domains: 12 grouped domains through their action enum, 9 leaf domains through an args struct. Leaf variants are single-field tuple variants, so all 21 arms read identically.
  - The explicit `+ Send` bound is deliberate: bare `async fn` in a trait carries no `Send` bound and would break a future `tokio::spawn`. It also removes the sync/async problem, because four domains never await.
  - Static dispatch only: monomorphised, no `Box`, no vtable, no allocation. A registry or `Box<dyn>` dispatch is **rejected** — the command set is a closed enum the compiler enumerates exhaustively.
  - The exhaustive `match` **remains**: it converts `Commands` into the concrete type, which is where exhaustiveness is enforced.
  - **Revisit trigger**: if the command set becomes dynamic or plugin-loaded, the factory precondition appears and D8 reopens.
  - The trait must not exist before its first impl: `wm-cli` is a binary crate, so a `pub trait` with no implementors is dead code.
  - Naming recorded: `std::process::Command` is used only inside the init domain, fully qualified and never imported, so it cannot collide with the trait; keep it that way.

  ## Verification of C-domain

  Measured on the committed tree after `5cfba93`: **0 cross-domain imports**. Every domain points at `shared/{models,traits,services,helpers}` and `wm-core`; intra-domain `super::<own>_helper` stays inside its own directory. This is the invariant a future check should enforce.

  ## Size budget and enforcement

  **300 lines per file, `main.rs` at most 80, functions at most 20 (named exceptions above).** Measured largest files: health_service 281, health_audit_helper 249, page_service 240, search_service 230, init_service 215, init_wizard_helper 208, graph_renderer 187. `main.rs` is **73 lines** — the 21 `mod` declarations consumed most of the remaining headroom against the 80-line cap; if a 22nd domain arrives, the cap or the bin/lib split must be revisited rather than exceeded.

  Enforced by a deterministic CI check in the `check` job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, following the `#[allow(...)]`-ban precedent. Note for future checks: an `-exec` loop body must not end in an `&&` list — that returns non-zero for every passing file, propagates through `find`, and reds the step under `bash -e`.
